text:
sam (platform): Quick sync idea — we need an SLO-driven routing flow that picks model variants + circuit-breaker behavior per customer tier and region. How do we annotate signals and surface this in the console?

Tess (api): +1. Can we avoid per-request heavyweight lookups? attach tier in JWT or edge header and do fast local decision.

juan (sre): Circuit breakers need two windows: burst (30s) and sustained (5m). Track latency_p95 and error_rate by region+variant. Also we should have a metric for variant_health.

li (console): Console needs a live decision trace for a request and a tenant SLO heatmap. Also an ops override to lock fallback off for specific tenants during incidents.

sam (platform): Sketch of router logic: 
```
# simplified pseudocode
if latency_p95(region,window) > tier.latency_slo:
  route_to_compatible_variant(tier,region,reason="latency_slo")
elif error_rate(region,window) > tier.availability_slo:
  trip_circuit_breaker(tenant,region,reason="availability_slo")
```
Keep it cheap and synchronous.

Tess (api): Where do tier configs live? we need versioned policy store (canary-able). Router reads a config hash cached in edge, invalidated on rollout.

juan (sre): Telemetry reqs: tag traces with chosen_variant, fallback_reason, cb_state, and required_features (streaming, function_calling). Emit counter fallback_count{tenant,region,variant,reason} and gauge cb_open_until{tenant,region}.

li (console): UX ideas: policy diff view, canary progress bar, and a simulator that runs sample prompts against the decision path showing expected latency/cost. Show "customer-facing expected degradation" when fallback is active.

sam (platform): Edge case: some variants lack streaming or tools. Router must consult a variant_capability_matrix and only fall back to compatible variants. Also expose capability mismatch in trace.

Tess (api): Customer visibility — should we show tenants "why" a fallback occurred (reason + expected quality delta)? We can surface a short note and link to docs. Need privacy guardrails.

juan (sre): Prevent cascading cross-region fallbacks: add global headroom budget per-tenant and per-model + per-region isolation. If one region trips, try nearby region only if latency budget allows.

li (console): Also add log-level controls per-tenant + a quick "replay" button to run recent requests through the simulator.

sam (platform): Next steps: draft RFC for policy schema and router implementation, telemetry mapping, and console mockups. Volunteers?

Tess (api): I'll own the policy schema + auth integration.

juan (sre): I'll own metrics, alerts, and circuit-breaker implementation in router.

li (console): I'll prototype console panels and the simulator UX.

sam (platform): Great. I'll draft the RFC and include a sample metrics mapping and rollout checklist.

deploy-bot: Created issue INF-2321: "SLO routing + fallback telemetry" <https://tracker.redwood.example/INF-2321> :rocket:

sam (platform): Thanks all — will share RFC draft in #eng-platform tomorrow for review. :thumbsup:
